info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fiduciary Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Fiduciary Agreement Retrieval API provides a mechanism for financial institutions and authorized users to access detailed fiduciary agreement information. This endpoint allows consumers, such as banking professionals and compliance officers, to retrieve specific agreements based on unique identifiers. By facilitating the access to these vital documents, the API helps ensure transparency and adherence to regulatory requirements in fiduciary relationships. Use cases include auditing, compliance checks, and client relationship management.

get.summary: Retrieve a fiduciary agreement by its ID
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the details of a fiduciary agreement using its unique identifier. It provides all relevant information associated with the specified fiduciary agreement, facilitating accurate and efficient access to the agreement's data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve information related to the fiduciary agreement identified by RES-100045 within the deposit lending context. Ensure that the necessary parameters are included to obtain the desired data.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the fiduciary agreement details.

GetFiduciaryAgreementByIdRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the fiduciary agreement in deposit lending operations.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the agreement.

principal.description: Details regarding the principal amount involved in the agreement.

termMonths.description: Duration of the loan term in months.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the agreement record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the agreement record.

metadata.description: Metadata associated with the response, including identifiers and timestamps.

GetFiduciaryAgreementByIdResponse_200.description: Response schema representing a lending fiduciary agreement operation.

amount.description: The principal amount of the loan.

currency.description: Currency in which the principal amount is denominated.

Principal.description: Schema representing the principal amount details.

correlationId.description: ID used for tracing the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the request was processed.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that was invoked to fulfill the request.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication method with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients are required to include a valid JWT in the Authorization header when making requests to access secure endpoints.
